lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn2Ag4 (ZnAg2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: each Ag has 12 geometric neighbors (8 Ag, 4 Zn) and each Zn has 12 neighbors (8 Ag, 4 Zn), with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.77–3.10 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis of the 12-vertex Ag and Zn coordination polyhedra shows corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns, though these selected relations do not assert an exclusive sharing type for all polyhedra.
